name: Koyal
long_description:
Koyal is an Agentic AI Filmmaking Platform that allows you to seamlessly convert script or audio into personalized, visually compelling stories. We’re a team from Carnegie Mellon, MIT and Meta, with experience in AI video generation.

https://koyal.ai builds directly upon our published research at the AI conference NeurIPS in December. We’ve been covered in the international press for our patented secure personalization protocol CHARCHA: the genAI captcha.

Announcement: https://x.com/meh_agarwal/status/1965866965425348687
Demo: https://x.com/meh_agarwal/status/1965137062119752099


We currently have paid pilots with the biggest global music labels, podcasts and production houses, and just launched our public beta at beta.koyal.ai

We recently concluded a pilot with Universal Music and T-Series (world’s largest music label) alongside Bollywood production houses like Maddock Entertainment, and Collective Artists Network! As part of that, we launched 5 music videos for Grammy and Oscar winning artists like A R Rahman, Ricky Kej and Shankar Mahadevan all crossing 1.5 million views!

We've recently built SOTA capabilities in (i) multilingual script to audio to video, (ii) Agentic lip-sync with dynamic movement & (iii) Multi-character consistency.

launches.tagline: Turn your script or audio to short films, music videos & launches
launches.body:
https://youtu.be/j5t8kEuZpSc?si=q_Jcbcnanrjl4h-N

TL;DR

Create cinema that feels real. Koyal captures emotional tone from your audio, turning emotion into cinematic scenes with consistent characters and settings. You can storyboard, direct, and edit every scene to perfection.

# **The Problem**

Filmmakers, musicians, and creators spend **weeks to months scripting, shooting, and editing** or pay **$100,000+** to agencies to get something that feels right.\
\
Even with new AI tools, you’re still wrestling with prompting, uncanny performances, and inconsistent characters.

# **The Solution**

Koyal lets you speak your story once, and watch it come to life.\
We capture the **emotional tone** in your voice or script and translate it into expressive, cinematic performances with consistent characters, settings and storylines.

You can **storyboard, reshoot, and refine** each scene naturally, like directing your own crew: no complex prompts, no model wrangling, no editors needed.\
\
Just your voice, your script, and your vision.

# **How Koyal Works**

[Demo Video](https://youtu.be/6Slhq8fbQ1c?si=9OaAU2xVKzhEbre8)

* **Upload your script or record your voiceover**: Koyal understands the emotion, pacing, and intent behind every line.
* **Design your characters**: Create an AI character or safely place yourself in the film using **CHARCHA: our Character Captcha protocol** that ensures your likeness is used **with verified consent.**

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94569&key=user_uploads/2383496/0f411243-c4be-4b15-af57-b5ae3f957e2d)

* **Craft your world:** Create or find real-life locations to shoot your movie in, add assets and choose art styles (animated, realistic, etc.)
* **Auto-generate cinematic scenes**: complete with consistent characters, environments, and shot logic.
* **Storyboard and edit visually**: adjust lighting, camera angle, or emotion directly with simple directions like “make it more hopeful” or “change the setting to night.”
* **Export your finished film**: ready to share across YouTube, socials, or investor decks.

# **In Action**

We’ve battle-tested Koyal across **music, media, and startups**.

* Worked with **Universal Music**, **T-Series**, and major Bollywood studios.
* Created videos for **Grammy and Oscar-winning artists** like [A.R. Rahman](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BeaAHxFl-6A), [Ricky Kej](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xT7NTK_Y_TY), and [Shankar Mahadevan](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZSkpEaud9-o), each crossing **1.5M+ views**.
* Partnered with **22 YC companies** to create their [launch videos](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/y-combinator_brickanta-isthe-construction-estimator-and-activity-7378775629376364544-A2vW?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAABZ8s4EB2S4yNxvn-aoVAyfMlfkG_me_3f8) in days, not weeks.

**Who We Are**

We’re **Mehul and Gauri Agarwal**, a brother-sister team obsessed with reimagining how stories are told. \
\
We are a team from MIT, CMU and Meta with experience building in AI video. Koyal evolved directly from our [research published at Neurips 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02610).

# **The Future of Filmmaking**

Koyal is inspired by how **Pixar builds stories** : audio first, visuals second.\
We aim to replace the camera with intelligent AI systems that understand how to **translate human intent into cinematic storytelling**.

You no longer need cameras, expensive sets and set pieces, or prompts: just your voice and imagination.

Try it now at[ ](https://koyal.ai)[koyal.ai](https://koyal.ai/)

We can’t wait to see what _you_ create.\
Mehul & Gauri 

\- kookoo
